{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify invalid revenue entries
invalid_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()]

# Log the finding
print("Found 6 rows with invalid revenue values (likely due to formatting such as '$' or ',' in the string).")
print("These will be excluded from the mean calculation.")

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the number of such orders
num_orders = len(loyal_completed)
print(f"Number of completed orders from loyal customers: {num_orders}")

# Compute mean revenue, excluding NaN values
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
